color.note: Ember (dark maroon) is the primary theme and the fallback for any token without a Rosé value. Text pairs hold 4.5:1 on the surfaces each note names, in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: The floating rails (navigation and quick launch). The deepest layer.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: The window canvas behind every page.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Inputs, the search pill, hovered rows and cards, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected fills, progress tracks, the active rail button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Chip outlines, dashed selection rings, dividers that group content.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Text-field, toggle and checkbox borders. Holds 3:1 on bg-100 through bg-300 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-000 through bg-400.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and descriptions on bg-000 through bg-400.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Counts, units, timestamps and placeholders on bg-000 through bg-300.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: The coral accent as a FILL: Play, primary buttons, the active rail button, toggles. Its label is on-flare.

tokens.name: flare-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (deepens rather than glows).

tokens.name: flare-press
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: flare-glow
tokens.usage: Decorative coral for gradients, glows and the hero card. Never behind text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a flare fill, both themes.

tokens.name: flare-text
tokens.usage: Coral as TEXT or icon: highlights inside titles, links, the active tab, on bg-100 through bg-300 and flare-soft.

tokens.name: flare-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind flare-text: the Manual tag, a highlighted row.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The second accent as a FILL: favourite stars, stat bubbles, the snapshot-count pill. Its label is on-cream.

tokens.name: on-cream
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cream fill.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Means Google Drive, always with the cloud icon. Text and icons on bg-100 through bg-300 and cloud-soft.

tokens.name: cloud-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Drive storage tag.

tokens.name: local
tokens.usage: Means on this PC, always with the drive icon. Text and icons on bg-100 through bg-300 and local-soft.

tokens.name: local-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the PC storage tag.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Created, verified, in sync. Always with a check icon and a word. Text on bg-100 through bg-300 and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and toasts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a decision: conflicts, queued uploads, unprotected play. Always with the alert icon. Text on bg-100 through bg-300 and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and the conflict banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or destructive. Always with an icon and a word. Pinker than flare so an error never reads as the accent. Text on bg-100 through bg-300 and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error badges and inline errors.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive confirm button; its label is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger-fill button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px with a 2px gap. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The dark ground under artwork scrims, identical in both themes so art always sits on dark.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on artwork, on the coral hero card and on stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on artwork scrims and the coral hero card.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: an alias of flare-text.

families.sans: "Outfit", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding headlines and a hero title when a game has no logo.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Totals in stat panels. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: The page greeting or page title; one per page.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, snapshot names, list-row titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your current save is copied to a safety snapshot first.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Floating panels sit 12px apart; page sections 28px apart.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between floating panels and between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (small cards); gap between game tiles.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (large cards).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; hero-card inset.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding at 1920.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, keyboard keys, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, inputs, snapshot thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, small cards, menus, game covers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards, the hero card, dialogs, the rails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The window and the onboarding panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search, chips, round icon buttons, progress bars.

shadow.note: Depth comes from surface steps first; shadows only on what floats or is lifted.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Lifted game tile, hovered card.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Under the Play button and the active rail button.

size.note: Component dimensions. Pointer targets are at least 32px; primary actions 40px or more.

tokens.name: caption-h
tokens.usage: Window caption strip (drag area + minimize / maximize / close).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Navigation rail and quick-launch rail width.

tokens.name: rail-w-expanded
tokens.usage: Navigation rail with labels.

tokens.name: rail-btn
tokens.usage: Round rail buttons and quick-launch game icons.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small pill buttons, chips, row actions.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Default buttons, search, inputs, dropdowns.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog confirm buttons.

tokens.name: control-h-xl
tokens.usage: The Play button.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Game rows and attention rows.

tokens.name: cover-w
tokens.usage: Minimum game-card width in the library grid.

tokens.name: hero-h
tokens.usage: Game detail hero card at 1366.

tokens.name: hero-h-collapsed
tokens.usage: Hero card on the Saves and Artwork tabs.

tokens.name: dialog-w-sm
tokens.usage: Simple confirmations.

tokens.name: dialog-w-md
tokens.usage: Create snapshot, restore.

tokens.name: dialog-w-lg
tokens.usage: Sync conflict, artwork picker.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog header icons.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Empty states, onboarding.
